{{Quote|His name is Kunn Kuroosh and all I know for certain is that his targets rarely survive and there are rumors that he's a Sith sorcerer. Don't take any chances with this guy. A thermal detonator would probably be the best weapon.|Kima Nazith|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Kunn Kuroosh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who served [[High Inquisitor]] [[Mal Sikander]] of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was rumored to be a [[Sith sorcerer]], whose targets rarely survived his assassination attempts. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Kima Nazith]], who served as both a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the bodyguard of [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]], commissioned a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with [[Death/Legends|killing]] Kuroosh. Nazith recommended using a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] against Kuroosh, who wielded a [[Color/Legends|red-bladed]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Darth Vader's lightsaber/Legends|similar in design]] to that of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:KunnKuroosh.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A known screenshot of Kunn Kuroosh as a Human female]]
[[File:LesserProphetDarksideTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|With the finalized template, Kunn Kuroosh would have only spawned under one of four possible "lesser prophet of the dark side" depictions.]]
Kunn Kuroosh was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

According to the game files, Kunn Kuroosh spawned under the generic "lesser_prophet_of_the_dark_side" template. As a result, his appearance was randomized under one of several appearances. At some point during the game's life span, the template was designed to include one of four possible depictions, including a male [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], male [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]], female [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], and [[Human/Legends|Human]] male.<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|game tree files}}</ref> However, a known screenshot of Kunn Kuroosh exists, depicted as a Human female. Earlier in the game's lifespan, this character model was incorporated as part of the "lesser_prophet_of_the_dark_side" template before being removed. In any case, while the [[canon]]ical [[Species/Legends|species]] of Kuroosh cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Kuroosh as male.<ref name="AED" />
